traceClockSource.derivation: Default NativeReasoningMemory clock is unmodified Date.now()/1000; authority constructs it without options. Each new reasoning:trace id must be bounded by its actual service.handle wall-clock interval.

qualification: Fresh functional pair of exact Site 108 published 0.67 and frozen final Chart candidate 0.68. Every role graph, delta, fragment, executable digest and ticket binding is independently validated. Full snapshots, proposals, decisions, common owner states and all raw graph leaves are compared. Only the three declared Chart roots and their content-verified reachable fragments may extend population; BranchRouting is common and retains no exemption. Source identity and explicitly proved coverage additions are attributed narrowly. Exact trace creation clocks are bounded by real Date.now intervals; activeSeconds is bounded by observed real performance.now and source elapsed counters. No clock is replaced, no field is omitted, no arbitrary timing normalization is allowed, and any unexplained difference fails qualification. Chart registration/negative foreign probes are not positive acquisition or official success. No original oracle, game engine, timing readiness or publication is authorized by this artifact.
